newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria reserves rise to $554.3 mln in March.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria reserves rise to $554.3 mln in March.

text.p: The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said on Thursday its foreign exchange reserves rose by $100 million to $554.3 million in March from $445.5 million in February.
BNB FX RESERVES, MARCH FEB MARCH'96 MLN USD

The BNB said in a statement that $271.9 million were held in current accounts and short-term deposits in foreign banks and $156.6 million were held in foreign securities and International Monetary Fund reserve position.
The statement said $87.151 million were held in precious metals deposited with first class foreign correspondent banks and $38.7 million were held in deposits in local commercial banks.
Central bank officials said reserves rose mainly due to purchases of foreign exchange on the local interbank market.
Bulgaria's monetary gold reserves held in the vaults of the central bank stood at 32.074 tonnes, or about 1.03 million troy ounces on March 31, said the BNB.

Under a $510 million 14-month International Monetary Fund standby accord agreed last month, Bulgaria pledged to introduce a fixed exchange rate system known as currency board in June to restore confidence in its financial system.
Under the accord, Bulgarian foreign exchange reserves are projected to rise to 700 million in June, Finance Minister Svetoslav Gavriiski said on Wednesday.
